## What changed?
Briefly explain the VISIO feature, bug fix, or documentation update.

## Related issue
Link the GitHub issue, if one exists.

## Verification
- [ ] I ran npm run build successfully.
- [ ] I checked the change on desktop and mobile (if UI-related).
- [ ] I confirmed that no secrets, real CCTV footage, RTSP credentials, or personal data are committed.
- [ ] I included screenshots or test results when relevant.

## Review
Request at least one teammate's review before merging to main.
The live VISIO website is deployed separately; GitHub merges do **not** automatically deploy.
